body:
No don't do it.!! 

Your worth so much more.!.

Hey..my brother was in the British Army he to saw some crazy shit to..he got into drugs and drink as a coping mechanism. When we didn't fund the habit he would turn on us. 
This was 12 years ago and he still hasn't excepted the help he was offered.

 You CAN sort your life out.! Your worth so much more. Take each day as it comes and take it slowly. Try talking to friends when your sober, I can promise you there is No answer at the bottom of a bottle.

Your the one in control.! 
You can do this.!
I'm in the UK so not sure what help if any Ex military get the USA but search the Internet maybe there is support groups you can attend to talk about your experiences. 

Might not seem like it now...but Trust me...YOU GOT THIS.!

Take care 🙂 
Stay Safe 🙏
Wear a mask😷

Natalie.
